sourceText.he: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: חַיָּה וָעוֹף וְכוּ׳. הָנֵי – הָא אַפְּקִינְהוּ לִכְדִשְׁמוּאֵל.

positions.claim: the three mentions of גדי exclude an undomesticated animal, a bird and a non-kosher animal from the prohibition of meat in milk
positions.basis: לא תבשל גדי בחלב אמו, written three times

positions.claim: the repeated mentions of גדי are needed for other derivations
positions.basis: Shmuel's teaching cited earlier in the tractate
